responsibility: Redirects the root of this server to the explorer.

outputs.name: load
outputs.description: The return value of load(), typed never: every call throws at redirect(308, '/harness') and never returns, so no page data is produced. It matters to anything expecting page data from this route, since none is ever returned.

errors.name: Redirect
errors.description: A SvelteKit redirect thrown by redirect(308, '/harness') from @sveltejs/kit, with status 308 to /harness. The throw is unconditional, because load() has no branch that skips the call, so it applies to every request that runs this load.
